column1: # One row per screenshot in this chapter: capture id, the date it was last CHECKED against current behaviour (or -),
# and the fabric_studio_core paths its content depends on (space separated; - = nothing in core).
# scripts/captures-fresh.py flags a screenshot when core changed those paths after the picture was taken or checked.
# "Checked" means someone compared what the picture shows with what the code does now, and wrote the date here.
# mcp-tools = the server's tool code (src/fabric_studio/mcp without the CLI-only files cli.py, connect.py, entry.py, skill.py).
